entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Huh, I didn't know you guys were out[n]together...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's just, I happened to remember[n]something about her, that's all!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, I caught myself thinking about[n]her earlier too. Odd coincidence, huh?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, I'm gonna head home for the[n]night. How about you, Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hmm... I'm gonna stick around a bit[n]longer.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I see. Don't stay out too late, all right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You've got school tomorrow too,[n]so get to bed at a reasonable time.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mom really is gone again... Sojiro sees[n]it that way too now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: O-Oh yeah! I forgot to tell you what[n]happened before we came to rescue[n]you!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We all ended up here at the same time[n]after you left for Odaiba...
